BUSH

GEORGE W. BUSH

Sec. 2. Exceptions.  (a) No individual who is serving in an office listed in section 1 in an acting capacity, by virtue of so serving, shall act as Director pursuant to this memorandum.  (b) Notwithstanding the provisions of this memorandum, the President retains discretion, to the extent permitted by the Federal Vacancies Reform Act of 1998, 5 U.S.C. 3345-3349d, to depart from this memorandum in designating an acting Director.  Sec. 3. Publication.  You are authorized and directed to publish this memorandum in the Federal Register.  George W. Bush [Filed with the Office of the Federal Register, 8:45 a.m., March 12, 2003]
